T282F.regime: f = 500 Hz far below the 140 kHz self-resonance

T9559.regime: f = 500 Hz far below the 140 kHz self-resonance

defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: The problem declares the inductor ideal, but T282F/T9559 give it a 140 kHz self-resonance, which requires parasitic capacitance an ideal inductor does not have.
defect_reasons.other: The K regime's out-of-regime 'reference expression' substitutes the self-resonant frequency q for the operating frequency in atan((2 pi q L - 1/(2 pi q C))/R), which is not the physics of self-resonance (effective inductance L/(1-(f/q)^2)); the threshold q > 10 f is also loose (about 1 percent change in X_L, ~0.9 deg at q = 10 f), though all listed values are far inside.

counterexamples: At q = 10 f = 5 kHz the effective inductance rises by ~1 percent, X rises by ~0.79 ohm and phi by ~0.9 deg, so the stated regime boundary does not guarantee invariance at the certified precision (no listed value is near it).
notes: All certified answers verified: R = 30 -> 40.351 deg; R = 36.5 -> 34.93; 44 -> 30.08; 57 -> 24.09. C cancellation of the peak voltage is correct. D sentences (fan circuit, earlier run) correct; T2697/TEEB4 and T6DE7/T0B12 are proper minimal pairs. T3337/TD7F0 are declared numeral-free controls, so my pass-1 low rendering_not_minimal flag is withdrawn. The remaining high flag is the ideal-inductor vs self-resonance contradiction; if the panel treats 'ideal' as compatible with a stated far-off self-resonance, the item would otherwise be valid.
